principle: Use each public benchmark's official metric. Do not promote a selector using API-route-specific custom metrics, retained feature mass, NDCG, or a newly invented aggregate score.

baseline.deployment_precision: the exact precision and runtime selected on Jetson Xavier NX, to be frozen before deployment evaluation
baseline.comparison_rule: same images, questions, preprocessing, decode policy, cut point, token budget and hardware
baseline.current_control: corrected integer patch-wise L2 plus deterministic 3x3 spatial anchors

primary_quality.current_cv_bench_metric: official cv_bench_accuracy = ((ADE20K accuracy + COCO accuracy)/2 + Omni3D accuracy)/2
report_per_benchmark: absolute delta from local dense BF16
relative retention from local dense BF16 as a descriptive ratio
parse or format success when part of the official evaluator
paired confidence interval when sample-level pairing is available
primary_quality.aggregation_policy: Do not report a five-benchmark aggregate until all five official evaluations are present. Never fill missing benchmarks with local diagnostics.

development_and_confirmation.cv_bench_status: already repeatedly observed; valid for reproducible local comparison but not a pristine external holdout
development_and_confirmation.development_rule: A low-cost screening subset may reject a mechanism but cannot establish a publication claim.
development_and_confirmation.promotion_rule: Freeze the candidate before confirmation. On data not used to select the candidate, compare it against the same-budget corrected-L2 control with the official metric; require the pre-registered paired 95% confidence-interval lower bound to exceed zero before full-suite and hardware promotion.
allowed_runtime_inputs: visual features available at the frozen cut point

arms_for_next_algorithm_gate: same-budget corrected integer L2 plus 3x3 anchors

non_primary_diagnostics.claim_scope: mechanism diagnosis only; never a selector promotion criterion and never substituted for an official benchmark metric

latency.model_end_to_end_boundary: preprocessed model inputs ready on host through decoded model output; separately report H2D, vision prefix, selector, remaining vision, LLM prefill and decode when reliable
latency.application_end_to_end_boundary: image file open/decode through final parsed output, including processor, H2D, model, heterogeneous communication and postprocess
latency.heterogeneous_rule: All Jetson-to-FPGA and FPGA-to-Jetson transfers, synchronization, packing and unpacking are included in heterogeneous end-to-end latency. Report compute-only kernel latency separately, never as system latency.

report: TPOT when decode length is material
link bytes and measured effective bandwidth
efficiency.analytic_projection_policy: Label every analytic number as a projection with explicit bandwidth and overlap assumptions. It cannot be promoted to a measurement.

current_forbidden_claims: G>512 is a causal Prompt-routing rule
the current Prompt branch improves official quality
K96 is accuracy-equivalent to dense BF16
1 GbE heterogeneous execution is faster than the software selector
FPGA compute-only latency is end-to-end latency
